plan.notes: Psychology major, no concentration. Built directly from the official 2026-2027 University Catalog PDF 'Psychology Major (No Concentration)' Plan of Study Grid, cross-checked against the Major Requirements table on the same document. Elective slots modeled as choice placeholders: Mathematics Elective (3 cr, MATH 11009/11010/11022/12002), Science Electives (8 cr total incl. one lab: BSCI 10110/10120/CHEM 10060/10061), Developmental Area (PSYC 20651/30651/30656), Cognition/Learning Electives (PSYC 40445/40446/41043), Application of Psychological Science Elective (3 cr, e.g., PSYC 41573/41574 or PSYC 41980 option), ANTH/BSCI/PSYC electives (e.g., BSCI 30140/30156/40515, ANTH 48623/48810), PSYC upper-division electives. Foreign Language 8 cr (College of Sciences and Humanities B.S. requirement). Prerequisites follow the standard chain: PSYC 11762 -> PSYC 21621 -> PSYC 31574/31684.
